## PR title

The title must be a Conventional Commit (`feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `chore`, `ci`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `build`, `revert`, `style`). Squash-merge makes the title the commit on `main`, so write it to stand alone in a changelog.
